name: Affiliate experiment planner
why: A small affiliate pilot with commission limits and stop rules, the test to run before the launch-a-partner-programme workflow.

name: Influencer gifting planner
why: Picks creators by fit and writes the box card with the disclosure line, matching the gifting step of the creator-shortlist-and-outreach skill.

name: Send creators a gift and a brief to film from
why: A gifting plan, phone-video script and filming brief in one run, for brands that want creator content they can reuse.

name: Creator pay planner
why: Works out a flat fee or floor-plus-commission offer from real views, a companion to the commission-ceiling-check prompt.

name: Creator filming brief writer
why: Turns an approved script into talking points and a shoot order, to attach to the creator-brief-and-disclosure skill's brief.

name: Creator ad roster builder
why: Plans a roster of creators for ads with a gifting funnel and pay rule, for shops scaling creator content into paid ads.

name: Clipper program planner
why: A paid clipper programme that pays only for approved clips up to a cap, a capped-payout model to compare with affiliate commissions.

name: Turn your best posts and creator videos into ads
why: Ranks creator videos and turns the best into ad tests, once usage rights are agreed in writing.

name: Build a clear sponsorship decision brief
why: Decides whether a paid sponsorship or creator slot is worth it, with a capped pilot and a decision date.

name: Viral growth experiment planner
why: A small invite or referral test with limits, a starting point for the refer-a-friend-scheme prompt.
